text_block_list.text: I got a perfect score on my Japanese history test—!!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason

Today we shall hold a cola party in celebration!
Come now, you shall join me!!

Ugh... Uuugh, I feel sick from drinking too much...!
This isn't how it was supposed to go...!
